Then I confirm my answers (step 5) and get a result (step 6). The result will say whether I can go ahead and what must be done first, using my firm's written rules. Any 'Not sure' answers get a careful assumption, and the result will show me what it assumed so I or the AI risk team can correct it.
ticksMean: 'I've checked this answer' means I have read what the AI helper suggested, compared it with the phrase it quotes from my description, and agree it is right. The tick is my own sign-off, not the AI's. An untouched suggestion doesn't count and blocks Continue. Changing a suggestion to a different option counts as checking it too. A tick shows a human looked at it, not that the answer is correct.
